title.narrative: In 2025, UNICEF strengthened health promotion, disease prevention and outbreak response, and community engagement. These emergency efforts addressed disease outbreaks of mpox, cholera and measles, reaching over 26.5 million people with health messages during nationwide measles vaccination campaign, and 13.4 million with Mpox messages through Safaricom private sector partnership. In addition, 12,132 people participated in community dialogues addressing barriers to care and child protection, and 1,895 people used AAP feedback mechanisms. SBC also played a convening role in multi-sectoral efforts such as early childhood development, while also tackling systemic barriers to healthcare access and fostering resilience in vulnerable cross-border communities.
